pairsWith.noteUz: 5-6-unitlar (Planning Ahead, Food, Glorious Food) bo'yicha nazorat testi: kelajak rejalar, kasblar, must/mustn't/have to, oziq-ovqat, sanaladigan/sanalmaydigan otlar, restoran dialoglari.

scanNote:
PROGRESS TEST 3 - Units 5-6 (73-bet, PDF 67). Yuqorida to'q sariq 'PROGRESS TEST 3' va 'Units 5-6'. Katakchalar: NAME, CLASS, DATE, MARK, (Time: 20 minutes).

'Vocabulary & Grammar':
1) 'Fill in the missing words.' 1 Doctors mustn't ...... mistakes at work. 2 Is there anything to eat? I'm ...... . 3 There isn't ...... milk in the fridge. 4 The ...... at the restaurant were friendly and helpful. 5 Are you ...... to order, madam? 6 The food was rather ...... . We paid £30 per person. 7 Is ...... any butter left in the fridge? 8 There are a ...... biscuits in the cupboard. 9 How ...... bread do you need? 10 Would you ...... some strawberries? 11 Nurses ...... after patients in hospitals. 12 Are you ready ...... your test? 13 If I do ...... in my exams, my parents will buy me a bike. 14 I'm taking my test tomorrow, so ...... me luck. 15 "...... will lunch be ready?" "At 12.30." 16 "Don't forget to buy some eggs." "Don't worry, I ...... ." 17 You ...... eat so much junk food. 18 I'm ...... you can't see Mr Rogers. 19 I like ...... vegetables. 20 She works ...... a teacher in a primary school.
2) 'Choose the correct item.' 1 You have to ...... an appointment to see Dr Harris. A do B close C make. 2 Would you like to see the wine ......? A service B list C menu. 3 Buy three ...... of chocolate, please. A bars B jars C slices. 4 The price ...... a return flight from Gatwick. A includes B contains C shares. 5 Can I have a ...... of cake please? A bowl B piece C carton. 6 She's ...... medicine at university. A learning B passing C studying. 7 I look forward ...... from you soon. A hearing B to hearing C to hear. 8 Would you like ...... orange juice? A some B any C a few. 9 A doctor has to work ...... hours. A hard B long C much. 10 There isn't ...... sugar left. A many B a few C much.

'Communication':
3) 'Complete the dialogues.' 1 A: ......? B: Yes, please. I'd like an orange juice. 2 A: What ...... summer? B: We're going to Jamaica. 3 A: Would ...... the dessert menu, sir? B: No, thank you. I'm full. 4 A: Hello! ...... speak to Mr Robins please? B: I'm afraid not. He's in a meeting at the moment. 5 A: Do you ...... drink? B: Yes - an apple juice, please.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '73'.

5-6-UNITLAR TAKRORI - 20 ta
  bo'shliq.

    mistakes; Nurses LOOK after
    patients; works AS a teacher
  Oziq-ovqat miqdori: isn't ANY
    milk; Is THERE any butter; a
    FEW biscuits; How MUCH bread;
    Would you LIKE some
    strawberries?
  Restoran: The WAITERS were
    friendly; Are you READY to
    order?; rather EXPENSIVE (£30);
    I'm STARVING
  Imtihon: ready FOR your test; do
    WELL in my exams; WISH me luck

    can't ...

  = juda och.

exercises.explanationUz:
5-6-UNITLAR LUG'ATI VA
  GRAMMATIKASI.

  1 MAKE an appointment = qabulga
    yozilmoq
  2 the wine LIST = vinolar ro'yxati
  3 three BARS of chocolate
  4 The price INCLUDES = narxga
    kiradi
  5 a PIECE of cake
  6 STUDYING medicine at university
  7 look forward TO HEARING (to +
    -ing!)
  8 Would you like SOME (taklif)
  9 work LONG hours = uzoq soat
    ishlamoq

⚠ 'LOOK FORWARD TO + -ING':

  Bu yerda 'to' - predlog, shuning
  uchun -ing keladi.

exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBGA QARAB SAVOL TUZISh.

  1 'Yes, please. I'd like an orange
    juice' → Would you like
    something to drink?
  2 'We're going to Jamaica' → What
    are you doing this summer?
  3 'No, thank you. I'm full' →
    Would you like to see the
    dessert menu?
  4 'He's in a meeting' → Can/Could
    I speak to Mr Robins please?
  5 'Yes - an apple juice' → Do you
    want a drink?


⚠ 'I'M FULL':

  = to'ydim.


⚠ 'HE'S IN A MEETING':

  = u yig'ilishda.

items.textEn: A: ___?  B: Yes, please. I'd like an orange juice.
items.answer: Would you like something to drink
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'Yes, please ... orange juice' → 'Would you like something to drink?'

items.textEn: A: What ___ summer?  B: We're going to Jamaica.
items.whyUz: ⚠ Reja javobi → 'What are you doing this summer?'

items.textEn: A: Would ___ the dessert menu, sir?  B: No, thank you. I'm full.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'Would you like to see the dessert menu?'

items.textEn: A: Hello! ___ speak to Mr Robins please?  B: I'm afraid not. He's in a meeting at the moment.
A: Do you ___ drink?  B: Yes - an apple juice, please.

patterns.formula: There isn't much/any + SANALMAYDIGAN / There are a few + SANALADIGAN
patterns.exampleEn: There isn't much sugar left. There are a few biscuits in the cupboard.
patterns.exampleUz: Shakar ko'p qolmagan. Shkafda bir nechta pechenye bor.

patterns.formula: Would you like + some ... / to + FE'L?
patterns.exampleEn: Would you like some strawberries? Would you like to see the dessert menu?

patterns.formula: KIM + mustn't / shouldn't / has to + FE'L
patterns.exampleEn: Doctors mustn't make mistakes. A doctor has to work long hours.
patterns.exampleUz: Shifokorlar xato qilmasligi kerak. Shifokor uzoq soat ishlashi kerak.
